projects.description: Distributed on-demand home services marketplace built with Java, EJB, RabbitMQ, microservices, REST APIs, wallet-based booking, rollback handling, asynchronous confirmations, and admin transaction management.

Concurrent Java client-server multiplayer trivia game using socket programming and multithreading, with authentication, real-time countdowns, categorized questions, scoring, match history, and disconnect handling.
Flutter movie exploration application using Clean Architecture, BLoC, and REST APIs, with trending, popular and top-rated movies, genre filtering, detailed information, trailers, and search.
Real-time Flutter news application using BLoC/Cubit and NewsAPI, with category browsing, article details, keyword search, and in-app or browser reading.
Flutter event discovery and management application with event creation, category browsing, REST API integration, and Google Maps for exact venue locations.
Full-featured Flutter Islamic application with Qur'an content, Ahadeeth, live Islamic radio streaming, reciters, and a digital Tasbeeh counter.

Cross-platform Flutter internship platform connecting students with opportunities and companies with applicants, using Firebase authentication, real-time updates, REST APIs, and location-based services.
